note: Hard leaps sung down from Do, each found on a note of the scale under it (La, Mi, just under Sol); Do moves through six keys and the line about another key says what stays.

exercise.title: Hard leaps down from Do
exercise.why: A minor 3rd down from Do lands on La and a minor 6th down lands on Mi, two notes of the scale you already sing, so only the tritone is a new sound.

cells.text:
Press Start below to hear Do and start the mic. The leaps go down from Do: m3 is the minor 3rd, TT the tritone, m6 the minor 6th.
Hear the landing note in your head before you sing: the minor 3rd lands on La, the minor 6th on Mi, and the tritone a half step under Sol. Then sing that note on "oo" and hold it until Yes shows, and press Next below for another leap.
Practice until each drop lands without sliding into it.
When Do moves to a new key, the notes are new but the leaps still land on La, on Mi and just under Sol.
